text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before training, while talking with Nice Nature
and King Halo—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, King-san!
I saw your race the other day!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're watching my race?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
She was super cool, it gave me goosebumps!
Truly a King, truly a main character.
I wish I could run like that too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!
Looks like my first-rate running has fired you up!
Very well, I grant you permission to get heated!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
M-Me...!? No, no, no way!
We have an intra-class race coming up soon,
and I'd rather just support from the sidelines as a background character...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I kinda feel a real kinship with that.
Like, I know that feeling all too well."

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No way, Nature-san, to me you're...!
I'm way more of a background extra, so there's no way we're on the same level!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you just watched me run,
so why are you being so pessimistic?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fine, if that's how it is,
then we'll go cheer you on.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? When you say "we"...
does that mean I'm included too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the junior Umamusume's race that we'd promised to watch,
I visited the training course together with Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're already here. Yahoo~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're late.
Look, it's just about to start.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment the gates open,
the tracksuited Umamusume burst forth.
The junior Umamusume from before—seems to have gotten a slightly slow start.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the race enters its final stretch, the junior Umamusume
is positioned just behind the lead pack.
Conventionally, it's time to make a move, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Breaking out looks tough.
Maybe they're feeling a bit intimidated...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —...Do your best!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa...!? King?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"You decide for yourself who the star is!
You compare yourself to who you were yesterday, not anyone else!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Think about who the real star is:
the past you, or the you of today who has worked
so hard for this race!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, King...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa, she's surging forward...!
Where is that power coming from...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(King's cheering carries so much power.
She's not in the stands because she's a side character.
Even from the stands, King is the leading star...)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Then what about me? Am I a side character because I'm in the stands?
No, but King is a true protagonist—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then—cheered on by King Halo, a junior Umamusume dashed right past our eyes.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (It's sparkling...)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What the heck, I'm the only one
playing a side character right now... ngh!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Don't give uuup--!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Nature-san!
Thank you so much
for cheering me on!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
No no, good ol' Nature didn't do a siiiingle thing...
Anyway, congrats on 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No! I heard your voice.
Being cheered on by someone as strong and cool as you makes me feel, somehow—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—I felt like
I had become the main character too!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, then!
Thank you so very much!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Well, this is quite a pickle.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I-I'm not blushing!
I just got a little too carried away cheering,
that's all... This is...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Still, it's not a bad feeling, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed the junior Umamusume's race had
some kind of positive influence on Nice Nature!
